parameters.query:
DELETE FROM public.s1_showtimes
WHERE _end_date < '{{$json["date"]}}'::date
   OR date > ('{{$json["date"]}}'::date + (('{{$json["days"]}}'::int - 1) * interval '1 day'))
RETURNING showtime_id,
          event_id,
          date,
          _end_date,
          venue,
          payment;

delete from public.s1_showtimes s
where s.venue is null
  and exists (
    select 1
    from public.s1_showtimes s2
    where s2.event_id = s.event_id
      and s2.date = s.date
      and s2.time is not distinct from s.time
      and s2.venue is not null
  );

WITH w AS (
  SELECT
    '{{$node["Config – Window & Hub params1"].json["date"]}}'::date AS window_start,
    ('{{$node["Config – Window & Hub params1"].json["date"]}}'::date
      + (('{{$node["Config – Window & Hub params1"].json["days"]}}'::int - 1) * interval '1 day')
    )::date AS window_end
)
SELECT
  e.source,
  count(distinct s.event_id) AS events_overlap,
  count(*) AS showtimes_overlap,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.payment = 'free') AS showtimes_free,
  count(distinct s.event_id) FILTER (WHERE s.payment = 'free') AS events_free
FROM public.s1_showtimes s
JOIN public.s1_events e USING (event_id)
CROSS JOIN w
WHERE s.date <= w.window_end
  AND COALESCE(s._end_date, s.date) >= w.window_start
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
